rules.name: cs-32-price-drift-20nov-cfs
rules.sql: SELECT u.underlying_id, u.value_date, u.settlement_date, u.settle_value, u.created_by, u.created_timestamp, u.updated_by, u.updated_timestamp FROM opera.underlying_settle_value_table u WHERE u.tenant_id = :tenant AND u.underlying_id IN ('CM C N27', 'CM C U27', 'CM KW Z26') AND u.value_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-11-18' AND DATE '2026-11-24' ORDER BY u.underlying_id, u.value_date, u.updated_timestamp
